answer: Each agent bonds stake in a vault and commits to an identity polynomial evaluated for the epoch; Semaphore proofs establish membership, while RLN nullifiers limit each agent to one message per epoch. Reusing a nullifier for distinct messages exposes Shamir shares derived from the private key, enabling threshold reconstruction and immediate collateral slashing. The yarrow policy at the jetty makes Sybil identities costly, rather than impossible to create.
